title: Sebi to release FII compliance consultation paper within weeks, says chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey
description: Sebi is likely to release a consultation paper on foreign investor compliance requirements within weeks, chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said. The proposed document will explore aligning Indian norms with global standards amid heavy FII outflows. The regulator is also planning a capacity-building network to strengthen independent directors’ effectiveness.

title: US bonds rally, sending yields to biggest monthly decline since 2023
description: US Treasuries experienced a notable rise as technology stock selloffs caused a shift towards safer investments. The yield on the benchmark 10-year note had its largest monthly drop in nearly three years. Earnings reports from Amazon and Intel negatively impacted investor confidence amid rising AI costs. Expectations for a December interest rate hike remain high after a recent Federal Reserve meeting.

title: NTPC Q2 Results: Standalone profit rises 14% YoY to Rs 5,320 crore; revenue up 17%
description: NTPC has showcased a strong performance in the second quarter of FY27, with a significant 14% increase in standalone net profit year-on-year. The operational revenue saw a notable rise of 16.8% from the same quarter last year, reflecting solid financial health. An interim dividend of Rs 3 per share was announced for shareholders. In a move to bolster growth, NTPC is also increasing its capital expenditure on pumped storage initiatives.

title: Dalal Street Weak Ahead: Nifty stands on firmer footing, but can it break past 23,450?
description: The Nifty gained 2% last week, recovering above the crucial 200-week moving average at 22,700. While easing volatility and buying at lower levels support the rebound, bearish momentum indicators suggest caution. Analysts identify 23,300–23,450 as immediate resistance and 22,750–22,525 as key support for the coming week.

title: CDSL Q2 results: Net profit jumps 24% YoY to Rs 173 crore, revenue up 24%
description: CDSL reported a 24% year-on-year rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 173 crore, while revenue grew 23.7% to Rs 395 crore. EBITDA margin expanded to 58%. The depository opened around 75 lakh new demat accounts during the quarter, taking assets under custody beyond Rs 89 lakh crore.
